_README: Thresholds for experiments/pulse/pulse_continuum.py. HUMAN-OWNED, like scheduler.json:
a pulse that can lower its own waking threshold has no threshold. Every weight below
is a named contribution — when necessity fires, reasons[] says exactly which of these
paid for it, so a wake is always explainable after the fact.
threshold  total score at or above which the tick takes WAKING ACTIONS.
Under it: silence. The stream line IS the continuum.
MOVED OUT: composite_move (and its weight) now live in config/watchdog.json. The
pulse no longer decides whether a composite movement warrants a cycle — it emits the
raw signal to memory/pulse_signal.json and experiments/watchdog/trigger_watchdog.py
